title: Eduqas GCSE Religious Studies Route A key concepts

source.title: Glossary of Key Concepts - Both Routes, Short Course and Full Course
source.scope: Full Course Route A: Component 1 Themes 1–4, Component 2 Christianity, Component 3 Option 3 Islam.

generation.method: Select a random concept from the chosen component and, for Component 1, the selected theme. Insert its term into the fixed stem. No AI question generation.
generation.stem: What is meant by the term “{term}”?
generation.template_note: This is the chosen practice stem. Real papers can use alternative wording, for example “What do Christians mean by ...?”.

marking_guide.1: Award 1 mark for a very simple definition or a relevant example.
marking_guide.2: Award 2 marks for a developed definition, with or without an example.
marking_guide.method: Students self-mark by comparing their response with the indicative content; no automated marking.
marking_guide.0: No creditworthy definition or relevant example.
marking_guide.one_word_or_example_only: An accurate one-word answer or an accurate example on its own receives 1 mark.

sharing_note: For Components 2 and 3, use one shared concept pool for Beliefs and Practices. Do not duplicate these keywords by section.

count_note: There are 48 official glossary entries across the six selected groups. Good/evil, relative/absolute poverty and greater/lesser jihad can be practised separately, giving 51 selectable terms.
definition_policy: Source glossary definitions are preserved with line wrapping normalised. Students may use their own accurate words; an example is not required for full marks.
